text: Although it was so brilliantly fine, with the blue sky powdered with gold, Miss Brill was glad that she had decided to wear her fur. <break time="0.8s" /> The air was perfectly still, but when she opened her mouth, there was just a faint chill, like the chill from a glass of iced water before you sip. <break time="0.8s" /> Great spots of light like white wine were splashed over the Jardins Publiques, the public gardens, and now and again a leaf came drifting down from the sky. <break time="0.8s" /> That afternoon she had taken the fur out of its box, shaken out the moth powder, and given it a good brush, feeling how nice it was to touch it again. <break time="0.8s" /> Then she had rubbed the life back into its dim little eyes, which seemed to ask her sadly, What has been happening to me. <break time="0.8s" /> Little rogue, she thought fondly as it bit its tail just by her left ear, and something light and sad, or rather something gentle, seemed to move in her heart. <break time="0.8s" /> There were a great many more people out this afternoon than last Sunday, and the band sounded louder and gayer because the Season had begun. <break time="0.8s" /> The conductor wore a new coat, and he flapped his arms like a rooster about to crow, while the bandsmen in the green rotunda blew out their cheeks.
